excerpt.en: Comedian Nikki Glaser has taken on a new agency, signing with WME in all areas. This follows eight years at UTA, during which Glaser rose to become recognized as one of today’s biggest comedy stars. Glaser currently holds three Emmy nominations for her Hulu special Good Girl and her work as host of the 83rd annual Golden Globe […]

title.en: Reggie Bannister Dies: ‘Phantasm’ Actor Was 80
title.fa: رگی بنیستر درگذشت: بازیگر «فانتاسم» 80 ساله بود

excerpt.en: Reggie Bannister, actor best known for starring in the Phantasm film series, has died. He was 80. The actor died on Sunday, August 9, in his home in Crestline, his wife, Gigi Bannister told TMZ. According to Bannister’s wife, the actor had been exposed to Agent Orange while serving in the U.S. military during the […]
excerpt.fa: رگی بنیستر، بازیگری که بیشتر برای بازی در مجموعه فیلم‌های Phantasm شناخته می‌شد، درگذشت. همسرش جیجی بنیستر به TMZ گفت که این بازیگر یکشنبه 9 آگوست در خانه اش در کرستلاین درگذشت. به گفته همسر بنیستر، این بازیگر در دوران خدمت در ارتش ایالات متحده در معرض مامور نارنجی قرار گرفته بود.
